page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ine.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon Sapphire Rapids processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and includes 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 7 Gbps. Given the balanced resource allocation of 4 vCPUs to 16.0 GB of RAM, the ecs.g8ine.xlarge is designed for general-purpose workloads. Suitable applications include web serving, application servers, development environments, and small to medium databases that do not require local high-speed storage or GPU acceleration.
